tweaks.name: Remove Clipchamp
tweaks.description: Removes Clipchamp for the current Windows user.
tweaks.impact: Removes the bundled video editor and its Start menu entry.
tweaks.tradeoff: Clipchamp projects require reinstalling the app. Undo depends on Windows retaining its package files.

tweaks.name: Remove Microsoft Solitaire
tweaks.description: Removes Microsoft Solitaire Collection for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Reclaims the app footprint and removes its Start entry.
tweaks.tradeoff: Solitaire games and progress synchronization require reinstalling the app.

tweaks.name: Remove Microsoft News
tweaks.description: Removes the bundled Microsoft News package for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes news content and associated app entries.
tweaks.tradeoff: Windows surfaces that rely on the package may show less news content.

tweaks.name: Remove Microsoft Weather
tweaks.description: Removes the bundled Microsoft Weather package for the current user.
tweaks.tradeoff: The standalone Weather app will be unavailable until restored.

tweaks.name: Remove Feedback Hub
tweaks.description: Removes Windows Feedback Hub for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes the feedback client and background package footprint.
tweaks.tradeoff: You will not be able to submit Windows feedback through Feedback Hub.

tweaks.name: Remove Get Help
tweaks.description: Removes the Get Help application for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes the consumer support app footprint.
tweaks.tradeoff: Windows support links may direct to the web instead of opening Get Help.

tweaks.name: Remove Microsoft 365 hub
tweaks.description: Removes the bundled Microsoft 365 hub app for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Removes Microsoft 365 promotions and the hub package.
tweaks.tradeoff: The Microsoft 365 launcher experience will be unavailable until restored.

tweaks.name: Remove Power Automate Desktop
tweaks.description: Removes Power Automate Desktop for the current Windows user.
tweaks.impact: Removes the bundled automation client when it is unused.
tweaks.tradeoff: Existing desktop automation flows require reinstalling Power Automate Desktop.

tweaks.name: Remove Dev Home
tweaks.description: Removes Microsoft Dev Home for the current Windows user.
tweaks.impact: Removes developer dashboard services and its app footprint when unused.
tweaks.tradeoff: Dev Drive and developer dashboard workflows may require reinstalling Dev Home.
